method: Direct inspection of decoded frames from unedited normal-camera raw captures, plus explicitly separate editor and installed-package environment fixture frames; exact source/build/input/telemetry retained separately
improved_boundary: Editor and installed runtime views retain dark coated steel after the first hit instead of tinting the entire sheet orange. The second hit detaches the sheet and opens the original passage; the installed fixture verifies damage, collision, debris and navigation behavior. The small impact mark is partly covered by the reticle, so these views do not fully establish its close detail or attachment during motion. The 720p ordinary-input run ended in native Success after 13.70411386800697 active seconds and 13 input actions, recording one bay power transition with no panel damage or electrical-floor damage. Its inspected 12-second and 15-second video frames show approach to the bay and unbroken dark panels beside the abrupt wet-floor edge; they do not show a damaged panel. The 1080p run ended in native Success after 8.804244222992565 active seconds and five input actions, with no bay power, panel or electrical-floor events. Its four-second frame shows the blue player, yellow rival and red infected on a sparse flat road with placeholder focal geometry and oversized HUD panels. Both runs contain native combat events, zero restarts and no captured audio; neither establishes the long-form route or full evolving arena consequence.

major_defects.finding: Blue/yellow/red mannequin presentation, primitive infected body and block-like weapon remain in the focal encounter.
The service bay gains authored construction detail, but the approach remains a broad empty road with repeated facades and primitive interior structure; dense vertical industrial layers are absent.

Ground wetness discontinuities, the flat green switch face and uniform orange panel-damage tint are repaired locally. The abrupt rectangular transition to dry road and flat surrounding surfaces still fail scene material coherence. The small panel impact detail remains partly reticle-occluded in fixture views.

The approach column/header now carry visible dark-red tissue and vascular branches. Close views still read as smooth rubbery, repetitive lobes with luminous seams, and the surrounding arena has sparse organic coverage. This local improvement does not establish a convincing coherent invasion.
Two motivated warm task lamps now illuminate the panels, but clear daylight and exposed sky still lack the required cold storm atmosphere and coherent scene-wide lighting contrast.

unproven: Current package-10 720p ordinary input records one bay power transition but no panel or electrical-floor event; the 1080p run ends near entry without any bay event. Package-04 ordinary consequence remains separately preserved. The package-10 fixture verifies native environment behavior but does not establish the full evolving player+rival+infected+arena composition. No natural arena_pressure transition is observed.

No final temporal-quality or raw audio qualification is claimed.
